fair_value_reason: Oct-2027 NTM (0.25 x CY27 + 0.75 x CY28), 207-208M diluted shares, 21% tax on all pretax income. (1) GAAP basis: taxed NTM GAAP EPS $7.10 (CY27 $5.57, CY28 $7.60 after SBC of 12% of revenue on $5.5B) x 23x, the SBC-expensed peer median = $163. (2) Adjusted basis: taxed NTM adjusted EPS $9.49 (CY27 $7.66, CY28 $10.10) x 17.2x, the SBC-added-back median = $163. (3) SBC-burdened FCF of about $1.45B at a 5% yield plus $4.0B of net cash = $161. Blend $162. This corrects my round-1 $168, which rested on an under-taxed CY27 EPS ($8.2), a mixed-basis 17.6x median and $3.5B of net cash.

thesis_triggers.event: Below about $105 RDDT would trade at about 13.7x taxed CY27 adjusted EPS of $7.66 (about 12x after about $19 a share of horizon net cash) and about 19x taxed GAAP $5.57, in the de-rated PINS/SNAP range and 12% under the $119.27 52-week low. That would mean the market is pricing a fundamental break (US DAUq falling for several quarters, a Google referral or licence cut-off, a guide-down), not 70%-vol noise. The agents range from $100 to $108 (mean $105.2).

supervisor_summary: Round 2 converged at $158-174, but the convergence is mostly anchoring on my round-1 inputs, three of which the agents themselves showed were wrong: the taxed CY27 EPS (about $7.66, not $8.2), EUR/USD (1.121, not 1.17) and the S&P announcement date (13 Aug). On one consistent SBC basis (23x GAAP-equivalent or 17.2x adjusted) RDDT already trades at a 15-18% premium to peers. That premium is not justified as persistent, given Google traffic and licence risk. Applying the median to taxed NTM EPS, plus about $4.0B of net cash, gives $162 (+7%). With 55-70% volatility and an unconfirmed Q3 print (29 Oct or 4 Nov), the ladder stays within about 1pp of the forecasters' mean.
key_drivers: Growth: Q2'26 revenue $805M (+61%) beat the top of guidance by about 11%. Q3 is guided to $860-870M with adjusted EBITDA of $385-395M. CY27 consensus is $4.46B (+32%).

Earnings basis: consensus EPS is almost untaxed (H1'26 tax $5.7M on $462.6M pretax). Taxed at 21%, CY27 is $7.66 adjusted and $5.57 GAAP, so RDDT is 19.8x and 27.2x, about 15-18% above a consistent peer median (17.2x adjusted, about 23x GAAP).
SBC intensity: about $0.68B a year run rate (12-13% of revenue, about $2.1 a share after tax). That is why GAAP and adjusted multiples diverge, and it was the source of agent_3's basis critique.
Traffic and Google: US DAUq was flat QoQ, the 10-Q cites search-algorithm effects, only $30.1M of licensing RPO is contracted for 2027, and the logged-in/out split is dropped from Q3.
Cash machine: H1'26 FCF was $572M on $2.2M of capex, with $2.79B of cash and no debt. Net cash at the horizon is about $4.0B (about $19 a share).
